fields.title: Finite volume schemes for two-phase flow in heterogeneous porous media
fields.text: We propose a monotone finite volume discretization of two-phase flow in porous media with discontinuous permeability. Numerical experiments on benchmark problems confirm the expected convergence on unstructured meshes.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Adaptive time stepping for stiff reaction-diffusion systems
fields.text: An adaptive controller based on embedded lower-order approximations is used to integrate stiff reaction-diffusion problems. The controller keeps the local error below a user-prescribed tolerance at minimal cost.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: A posteriori error estimates for mixed finite element methods
fields.text: We derive residual-based a posteriori error estimates for mixed formulations of elliptic problems. The estimates are robust with respect to jumps in the diffusion coefficient.
fields.department: Charles University, Faculty of Mathematics and Physics

fields.title: Numerical simulation of shallow water flows on unstructured meshes
fields.text: A well-balanced scheme for the shallow water equations with wetting and drying is presented. The method preserves lake-at-rest solutions on unstructured triangular grids.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Higher-order discontinuous Galerkin methods for compressible flow
fields.text: Shock-capturing strategies for high-order discontinuous Galerkin discretizations of the Euler equations are discussed. Limiter-based and artificial-viscosity approaches are compared on standard benchmarks.
fields.department: Brno University of Technology

fields.title: Parallel solvers for large sparse linear systems
fields.text: Algebraic multigrid preconditioners for massively parallel architectures are discussed. Weak scaling results on up to ten thousand cores are presented.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Model order reduction of parametrized partial differential equations
fields.text: Reduced basis methods for parametrized elliptic problems are reviewed with emphasis on a posteriori certification. Applications to heat transfer and elasticity are shown.
fields.department: University of West Bohemia

fields.title: Uncertainty quantification in groundwater flow models
fields.text: A multilevel Monte Carlo method for elliptic problems with random coefficients is analyzed. The variance reduction achieved by the multilevel estimator is demonstrated on a groundwater benchmark.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Particle methods for the Vlasov-Poisson system
fields.text: A convergent particle method with remapping for the Vlasov-Poisson system is presented. The remapping step controls the growth of particle noise over long time horizons.
fields.department: Palacký University Olomouc

fields.title: Spectral element discretizations of wave propagation problems
fields.text: High-order spectral elements are applied to the acoustic wave equation in complex geometry. Dispersive error analysis and time integration choices are discussed.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Machine learning surrogates for multiscale simulations
fields.text: Neural network surrogates replace the fine-scale solver in a multiscale elliptic problem. Training data requirements and the reliability of the surrogate are studied.
fields.department: Charles University, Faculty of Mathematics and Physics

fields.title: Structure-preserving integrators for Hamiltonian systems
fields.text: Variational integrators preserve energy behavior over exponentially long times. Several variants are compared on the nonlinear Schrödinger equation.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Optimal control of flows in vascular networks
fields.text: A reduced-order optimal control approach for flow in networks of elastic tubes is presented. The method enables fast parameter studies for physiological configurations.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Domain decomposition methods for coupled multiphysics problems
fields.text: Robin-type interface conditions are used to couple heat and flow subproblems. Convergence of the resulting iterative scheme is analyzed and verified numerically.
fields.department: Technical University of Liberec

fields.title: Parameter identification in reaction-diffusion models
fields.text: An adjoint-based approach identifies diffusion coefficients from sparse observations. Tikhonov regularization stabilizes the inverse problem.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Lattice Boltzmann methods for complex geometries
fields.text: A boundary treatment for lattice Boltzmann solvers on curved boundaries is proposed. Second-order accuracy is verified on problems in complicated domains.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Anisotropic mesh adaptation for singularly perturbed problems
fields.text: Recovery-based anisotropic error indicators drive mesh refinement for convection-diffusion boundary layers. The method resolves layers with far fewer degrees of freedom.
fields.department: University of South Bohemia

fields.title: GPU acceleration of explicit finite difference solvers
fields.text: Memory layout and kernel fusion choices for explicit stencil computations on modern GPUs are discussed. Speedups of two orders of magnitude are reported.
fields.department: Czech Technical University in Prague, FNSPE

fields.title: Verified numerics for enclosure of solutions of ODEs
fields.text: Interval arithmetic provides rigorous enclosures of solutions of initial value problems. The approach is demonstrated within the Taylor model framework.
fields.department: Charles University, Faculty of Mathematics and Physics
